title: I gave Claude my Instagram page — here's what it cost me
caption: Spent 7 days handing my Instagram strategy to Claude. The results — and the four prompts that actually moved the needle.

slides.sub: Here's what 7 days of AI-led content strategy actually returned.

slides.title: What 7 days
slides.cta: All from 7 carousels. No paid ads. Same posting cadence.

slides.definition: Feed Claude every carousel from your last 30 days as image attachments. Ask it to find the single pattern your top 3 posts share that your bottom 3 don't.
slides.example: Mine: a contrarian claim in the first 5 words. Always.

slides.title: The hook surgeon
slides.body: Paste your draft hook. Ask Claude: "Rewrite this 10 ways. Half contrarian, half curiosity-gap. Each <= 12 words. Mark the strongest 3." Pick from the marked three.

slides.title: The density rebalancer
slides.body: Paste your full slide-by-slide copy. Ask: "Map word count per slide. Where does density spike or collapse? Rebalance — tight ends, dense middle."

audiences.body: Anyone shipping 3+ posts per week and feeling the burnout. The system carries the cognitive load.
Service businesses managing 4+ client accounts. Standardize the writing process, charge premium for the consistency.
Solo builders treating content as a growth lever. Ships your edge without becoming your job.

slides.author: Adam H.
slides.body: Most creators are using Claude as a thesaurus. The real unlock is using it as your audit layer — what's working, what's noise, what to kill.

slides.title: Three mistakes
bullets: Asking Claude to "write a carousel" without context. Output is generic. Always paste your last 3 posts first.
Trusting first-draft hooks. Always force 10 variants. The 7th is usually the winner.
Forgetting the CTA. Save rate is the metric. CTA mechanic is what compounds saves into DMs into sales.
slides.footer: Skipping any of these = wasted prompts.
